documents.title: About Shiretechnik
documents.content: Shiretechnik Solutions Private Limited (Shiretechnik) was founded by a group of engineers in 2016. It is an Indian engineering and simulation consultancy firm specializing in advanced design and analysis services, with a strong focus on thermal and fluid systems. Our work combines engineering expertise with simulation-driven design to help organizations understand, validate, and optimize complex systems before physical implementation. We deliver CFD, thermal, CAE, and optimization solutions across marine, offshore, defense, industrial, building services, and electronics thermal management sectors.

documents.title: Engineering Intelligence Behind Complex Systems
documents.content: Shiretechnik is an advanced engineering and simulation consultancy specializing in thermal, fluid, and CAE-driven design solutions. Our core focus areas include CFD (flow and pressure), Thermal (heat transfer), Fire Safety (PyroSim and Pathfinder), and HVAC (airflow design). We provide engineering intelligence behind complex systems through simulation-driven design and optimization.

documents.title: Location and Headquarters
documents.content: Shiretechnik is headquartered at 166, 5th Main, K.E.B Layout, Sanjaynagar, Bangalore 560094, Karnataka, India.

documents.title: Office Hours
documents.content: Shiretechnik office hours are Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Closed on Sundays.

documents.title: Industries Served
documents.content: Shiretechnik serves Marine and Maritime, Naval Architecture, Defense, Offshore, Heavy Engineering, and Turbomachinery sectors, alongside building services (HVAC and fire safety) and electronics thermal management applications.

documents.title: Services We Specialize In
documents.content: Shiretechnik offers simulation-driven engineering services covering fluid dynamics, fire safety, thermal, and structural domains. Our core service offerings include CFD Analysis, PyroSim (fire simulation), Pathfinder (evacuation simulation), Ventus (engineering simulation), Thermal Analysis, HVAC Design, Mechanical Design, and Structural Design.

documents.title: Company Statistics
documents.content: Shiretechnik has been operating since 2016, with 20+ years of combined senior engineering experience, a team of 7 members, and 100+ projects delivered across marine, thermal, fire safety, HVAC, and CAE domains.
